evaluation.overall_comment: The translation successfully captures the educational dialogue and scientific content of the original podcast script in Croatian. It is largely complete and contextually appropriate for its intended format. However, it contains a recurring pattern of grammatical errors (case agreement, missing verbs, awkward word order) and a few mistranslations that disrupt fluency and readability. With targeted proofreading to correct case endings, standardize physics terminology (e.g., 'načelo' instead of 'princip', 'očuvanje'), and fix typographical/glitch artifacts, this would be a high-quality publication-ready translation. As is, it falls into the solid-to-good range but requires editorial refinement for native-level polish.
